item.title: AIMS at SIBGRAPI 2026
item.description: Maria Gabriela Lustosa, an undergraduate researcher at AIMS, presented her work on short-term object interaction anticipation at SIBGRAPI 2026 in Goiânia, Brazil. Her research explores how machines can anticipate interactions with objects from egocentric video.

item.title: AIMS at Interspeech 2026
item.description: Pedro Corrêa presented From Tokens to Faces: Investigating Discrete Speech Representations for 3D Facial Animation at Interspeech 2026. The work investigates discrete speech representations for generating 3D facial animation. Read the paper ↗ · Project and demos ↗
